description: This file is a FastAPI application implementing backend API endpoints for file uploads, question-answering, references retrieval, chart data, query history, and admin functionalities. It defines routes, models, middleware, and integrates with other modules for handling various aspects of a knowledge base system.

classes.name: QAQuery
classes.description: Data model for question input in the /query endpoint.

classes.name: QAResponse
classes.description: Data model for responses from the Q&A endpoints.

classes.name: ReferenceList
classes.description: Data model for list of references.

classes.name: ChartData
classes.description: Structure for chart data for visualization.

classes.name: QueryHistoryItem
classes.description: Represents a single saved query and answer with timestamp.

classes.name: HistoryList
classes.description: Container for list of history items.

classes.name: HistoryDeleteRequest
classes.description: Model for deleting a history entry by timestamp.

methods.name: health_check
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify system health.

methods.name: upload_file( file: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload") )
methods.description: Handles file uploads and metadata storage.

methods.name: submit_query(payload: QAQuery)
methods.description: Processes user questions and returns answers with references.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Retrieves an answer to a question via query parameter.

methods.name: get_references
methods.description: Returns a static list of reference document filenames/links.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Provides mock chart data for visualization based on chart type.

methods.name: delete_history
methods.description: Deletes a specific history entry by timestamp.

methods.name: get_admin_portal
methods.description: Provides admin dashboard data, with optional token auth.
